patches.decision_note: Actual connection-record removal and front-end success reporting are independently testable: the backend revocation fails while the front end separately refuses to report false success.

replacement.title: Invited-User Acceptance Flow
replacement.definition: An invited user must be able to follow an invitation route and complete account acceptance through the acceptance API.

patches.decision_note: The absent invitation landing route and acceptance API call describe an independently testable multi-user behavior missing from the inventory.

replacement.title: Account Member Management
replacement.definition: The multi-user account flow must provide backend-supported capabilities to list members and revoke or remove their access.

patches.decision_note: Member listing and revoke/remove capabilities are product behaviors distinct from invitation acceptance and are explicitly reported as absent.

replacement.title: Owner-Facing Per-Member Usage Metering
replacement.definition: Account owners must have access to per-member token consumption, usage breakdowns, and individual-limit information rather than those capabilities being restricted to superadmins.

patches.decision_note: Owner-facing per-member metering is an independently described behavior with a concrete current access gap and unresolved Release 1 scope.
The client narrows the Release 1 audit to the Connector Module; the Release 1 context remains applicable rather than being replaced.
